facts.value: These courses aim to convey communicative and intercultural foreign language skills, refresh and complete existing basic knowledge of the Spanish language, and provide subject-specific vocabulary as well as an initial insight into general aspects of the economy of Spain and Latin America.
Two levels are offered.
Business Spanish 1 - Base
A2.2 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
Completion of Level A1 of the GER or 40 - 60 points in the placement test.
It is recommended to take the placement test before registration to ensure correct course placement.

In Business Spanish 1 - Base, you will learn vocabulary and phrases specifically for the business world. You will gain extensive knowledge of the Spanish language, as well as insights into the country, its society, and business-related topics such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends. A variety of exercises will also promote linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics and lay the groundwork for discussions and written exercises on various economic subjects.
The number of participants is limited to a maximum of 20.

value: Unit 2 - Business Development - From the Past to the Present
Unit 3 - Types of Companies in the Spanish-speaking World

facts.value: Oral participation and presentation, written examination in the last week of lectures.
A graded certificate is issued upon successful completion of the examinations.
90 Euros
WSP1 Base (13 double hours, including final examination).
Business Spanish 2 - Consolidation
B1.1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
Completion of Level A2 of the GER or at least 60 points in the placement test.

In Business Spanish 2 - Consolidation, you will learn vocabulary and phrases specifically for the business world. You will gain extensive knowledge of the Spanish language, as well as insights into the country, its society, and business-related topics such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends. A variety of exercises will also promote linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics and lay the groundwork for discussions and written exercises on various economic subjects.
The number of participants is limited to a maximum of 20.
